skills.name: bookkeeping
skills.description: Record and categorize transactions using double-entry basics and reconcile accounts against bank and card statements, returning a correctly-categorized ledger plus an exceptions list of miscategorizations and duplicates.

skills.name: cash-flow
skills.description: Track cash in versus out and build a short rolling cash-flow forecast, returning the current cash position, a forward forecast by period, and flagged risks like runway, shortfalls, and timing gaps.

skills.name: financial-statements
skills.description: Produce and explain the three core financial statements — income statement, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement — from bookkeeping data, returning clean statements plus a plain-English read of what stands out.

skills.name: invoicing
skills.description: Create clear invoices, track outstanding and aging receivables, and run a polite escalating follow-up sequence on overdue accounts, returning the invoice, an aging view, and the next follow-up message to send.

skills.name: monthly-close
skills.description: Run a repeatable month-end and quarter-end close — reconcile, accrue, review for errors, lock the period, and summarize — returning a close checklist and a short month summary.

skills.name: tax-prep
skills.description: Organize records ahead of tax filing — categorize deductible expenses, assemble the document checklist, and flag gaps — returning an organized tax packet and an open-items list, as preparation only and not tax advice.

skills.name: crm-hygiene
skills.description: Audit and clean customer, contact, and lead records — dedupe, standardize fields, fill gaps, and flag stale entries — producing a cleanup report plus the corrected records.

skills.name: lead-qualification
skills.description: Score and prioritize inbound leads against a lightweight fit-plus-intent framework and recommend the next action for each, producing a ranked list with reasons and a next step.

skills.name: outreach
skills.description: Draft personalized cold or warm outreach and a short multi-touch follow-up sequence — tight, specific, with one clear ask — producing a ready-to-send sequence of short messages.

skills.name: pipeline-review
skills.description: Review the deal pipeline — flag stalled and at-risk deals, sanity-check stages and the forecast, and recommend where to focus — producing a pipeline-health summary with prioritized actions.

skills.name: prospect-research
skills.description: Build a concise, factual one-page brief on a prospect or account before outreach or a call — who they are, likely needs and pains, and relevant hooks — research only, not the message.

skills.name: customer-escalation
skills.description: Handle an upset customer or a cross-team hand-off by de-escalating, packaging the issue with full context for whoever must act, and proposing a resolution path, producing an escalation summary plus a customer-facing reply.

skills.name: kb-article
skills.description: Turn a resolved issue or a recurring question into a clear, reusable help-center article covering the problem, steps, and gotchas, producing a structured KB article ready to publish.

skills.name: ticket-triage
skills.description: Categorize, prioritize, and route an incoming support ticket and draft an accurate first reply, producing a triaged ticket with category, priority, and owner plus a ready-to-send response.

skills.name: brand-voice
skills.description: Define and enforce a consistent brand voice — capturing tone attributes with do/don't examples, then reviewing drafts against them — producing a voice guide and/or a marked-up review.

skills.name: campaign-planning
skills.description: Plan a marketing campaign end to end — goal and target metric, audience, channels, core message, content calendar, and measurement — producing a complete campaign plan.

skills.name: content-creation
skills.description: Draft on-brand long-form content — blog posts, newsletters, landing-page sections — from a brief, structured for the audience and goal with a clear next step, producing a ready-to-edit draft.

skills.name: copywriting
skills.description: Write high-converting short copy — headlines, CTAs, subject lines, ad and social hooks — using proven frameworks, delivering several labeled options plus the rationale behind each.

skills.name: seo
skills.description: Optimize content for search — mapping keyword intent, structuring on-page elements and internal links, and auditing an existing page for quick wins — producing an SEO review with concrete edits.

skills.name: employee-onboarding
skills.description: Generate a role-based onboarding plan for a new hire's first day, week, and month — access and accounts, key introductions, ramp tasks, and 30/60/90 milestones — as a ready-to-use checklist.

skills.name: hiring
skills.description: Run a hire end to end — write an inclusive job description, define must-have versus nice-to-have criteria, screen candidates against them, and structure the pipeline — producing a JD, screening rubric, and stage plan.

skills.name: interview-prep
skills.description: Build a structured interview kit for a role — the competencies to assess, a behavioral and role-specific question bank, and a scorecard — so every candidate is evaluated fairly and consistently.

skills.name: performance-review
skills.description: Prepare a fair, evidence-based performance review — gather concrete examples, structure feedback into strengths, growth areas, and goals, and keep it specific and actionable — producing a review draft.

skills.name: product-brainstorming
skills.description: Run a structured ideation session — frame the problem, diverge widely, cluster themes, then converge by scoring impact against effort — producing a shortlist of ideas with rationale.

skills.name: research-synthesis
skills.description: Synthesize qualitative research — interviews, surveys, support tickets, reviews — into themes, insights, and recommended actions grounded in evidence, producing a synthesis with supporting quotes and counts.

skills.name: roadmap-planning
skills.description: Build and maintain a roadmap — group initiatives into themes and now/next/later horizons, sequence by value and dependency, and keep it current as priorities shift — producing a roadmap view plus a near-term plan.

skills.name: writing-specifications
skills.description: Turn an idea into a clear spec or PRD — problem and why-now, target users, goals and non-goals, scope, requirements, success metrics, risks, and open questions — producing a document the team can build from.

skills.name: analyzing-data
skills.description: Explore a dataset to answer a specific question — profile it first, then surface trends, outliers, and segments — and report findings honestly with the numbers and caveats behind them.

skills.name: building-dashboards
skills.description: Design a clear KPI dashboard — pick the few metrics that matter, lay them out by importance with the right comparisons, and cut vanity numbers and clutter — delivered as a layout spec.

skills.name: creating-visualizations
skills.description: Choose the right chart for the question — trend, comparison, distribution, part-to-whole, or relationship — and present it cleanly with honest scales and clear labels, ready to build.

skills.name: statistical-analysis
skills.description: Apply sound basic statistics without overreaching — pick the right summary or test, check assumptions, separate correlation from causation, and state significance and uncertainty plainly.

skills.name: writing-queries
skills.description: Write correct, readable SQL to pull the data you need, then verify the result is actually right with row counts, spot-checks, and edge cases before trusting it.

skills.name: design-systems
skills.description: Establish and maintain a small, practical design system — tokens, a core component set, and usage rules — and capture it as a compact system spec teams can actually follow.

skills.name: ux-copy
skills.description: Write clear interface microcopy — buttons, labels, empty states, errors, tooltips, onboarding — that is concise, human, and tells the user what to do next, delivered with placement and context notes.

skills.name: contract-review
skills.description: Review a routine business contract or NDA for a non-lawyer by surfacing key terms, obligations, dates, and liabilities, flagging risky or unusual clauses, and listing questions to raise, producing a plain-English summary with flagged clauses.

skills.name: process-improvement
skills.description: Document and improve a business process by mapping its current steps and handoffs, finding bottlenecks, rework, and waste, then proposing a leaner version with named owners and a current-vs-proposed comparison.

skills.name: risk-and-compliance
skills.description: Identify and track operational risks and compliance obligations in a register — rating each by likelihood and impact, assigning owners, and defining mitigations and review dates — producing a maintainable risk and compliance register.

skills.name: status-report
skills.description: Compile a crisp cross-functional status update covering progress since last time, what is on track versus at risk, decisions needed, and next steps, structured to be read in under a minute.

skills.name: vendor-management
skills.description: Evaluate and manage vendors and suppliers by scoring options against weighted criteria, tracking contracts, renewals, and spend, and running a periodic vendor review, producing a vendor scorecard and review summary.

skills.name: architecture
skills.description: Design or review a software architecture by clarifying requirements and constraints, weighing options with explicit trade-offs, choosing one, and capturing the decision as an architecture sketch and decision record.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review a diff, pull request, or file for correctness bugs, risky patterns, and maintainability issues, reporting prioritized findings with concrete fixes.

skills.name: debugging
skills.description: Debug a problem methodically — reproduce it reliably, isolate the cause by bisection, test one hypothesis at a time, find and fix the root cause, then verify with a regression test, reporting the cause, fix, and verification.

skills.name: deployment
skills.description: Ship a release safely with a pre-deploy checklist, a rollout strategy that includes a rollback plan, and post-deploy verification and monitoring, producing a deployment checklist.

skills.name: documentation
skills.description: Write or update technical documentation — READMEs, API references, architecture overviews, and runbooks — that stays accurate to the code and useful to its audience.

skills.name: incident-response
skills.description: Respond to a production incident calmly — assess severity, stabilize and mitigate before diagnosing, communicate clearly throughout, resolve, then run a blameless post-mortem with action items — producing an incident timeline and post-mortem.

skills.name: standup
skills.description: Compile a concise standup update — what shipped, what is in progress, and what is blocked — from recent commits, pull requests, and task activity.

skills.name: tech-debt
skills.description: Identify, assess, and prioritize technical debt by cataloging it, estimating ongoing cost and risk against effort to fix, and proposing a realistic paydown plan tied to upcoming work, producing a prioritized tech-debt list.

skills.name: testing-strategy
skills.description: Decide what and how to test — the right mix across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels, what to cover first by risk and blast radius, what not to test, and what "done" means — producing a testing plan.

skills.name: daily-briefing
skills.description: Produce a fast morning briefing across the whole business — what needs attention today, what is due or overdue, what changed since yesterday, and the top priorities — producing a scannable briefing.

skills.name: knowledge-management
skills.description: Organize the knowledge base so information stays findable and current — structuring collections, setting what is worth capturing, keeping documents deduped and up to date, and retiring stale content — producing an organized knowledge base with capture and retention rules.

skills.name: meeting-notes
skills.description: Turn raw meeting notes or a transcript into useful structured notes — a short summary, the decisions made, and action items with owners and due dates — producing notes the team can act on.

skills.name: memory-management
skills.description: Decide what the assistant should durably remember versus look up each time — keeping a small set of stable, high-value personal and operational facts, pruning the rest, and redirecting document-sized information to the knowledge base — producing curated memory entries and a list of what to drop.

skills.name: search-strategies
skills.description: Find information efficiently — designing good queries, iterating between broad and narrow, using synonyms and filters, evaluating source quality, and knowing when enough has been found — producing an effective search approach and the answer.

skills.name: task-management
skills.description: Capture, organize, and prioritize tasks and projects so nothing slips — a trusted capture habit, clear next actions, priorities and due dates, reviewed regularly — producing an organized, prioritized task list.

skills.name: team-messaging
skills.description: Write clear, well-structured team-chat messages and announcements — leading with the point or ask, formatting for skim, setting context and urgency, and making the next step explicit — producing a ready-to-send message.
